minecraft:extinguish_light.name: Snuffed Light
minecraft:extinguish_light.description: Snuffs a lit candle nearby, or knocks a torch off its mount so it drops as an item.

minecraft:candles_out.name: Candles Out
minecraft:candles_out.description: Every lit candle within range goes out at once.

minecraft:torch_chain.name: Torch Chain
minecraft:torch_chain.description: Up to eight torches are knocked off one after another, the nearest to the player last.

minecraft:lantern_flicker.name: Lantern Flicker
minecraft:lantern_flicker.description: A lantern vanishes and returns three times in a blink, then stays where it was.

minecraft:lamp_off.name: Lamp Off
minecraft:lamp_off.description: A lit redstone lamp switches off for a second, then comes back if still powered.

minecraft:campfire_out.name: Campfire Out
minecraft:campfire_out.description: A lit campfire is snuffed out.

minecraft:furnace_dies.name: Dying Furnace
minecraft:furnace_dies.description: A burning furnace goes cold and its fuel is taken out for five seconds, then returned.

minecraft:candles_light.name: Candle Lights Itself
minecraft:candles_light.description: An unlit candle nearby lights on its own.

minecraft:new_face.name: New Face
minecraft:new_face.description: A jack o'lantern slowly turns to face another way.

minecraft:blackout.name: Blackout
minecraft:blackout.description: Lights nearby go out and break, and a moment later a zombie or skeleton appears close by and attacks.

minecraft:burning_hand.name: Burning Hand
minecraft:burning_hand.description: The torch or lantern held in the main hand is dropped as if it burned.

minecraft:door.name: Door
minecraft:door.description: A wooden door opens by itself, or an open one slams shut.

minecraft:trapdoor.name: Trapdoor
minecraft:trapdoor.description: A wooden trapdoor flips with a slam.

minecraft:fence_gate.name: Fence Gate
minecraft:fence_gate.description: A fence gate swings open or shut.

minecraft:pressure_plate.name: Pressure Plate
minecraft:pressure_plate.description: A pressure plate triggers for a second with nothing on it.

minecraft:iron_door.name: Iron Door
minecraft:iron_door.description: An iron door opens or shuts without any redstone.

minecraft:breathing_door.name: Breathing Door
minecraft:breathing_door.description: A door opens and closes once a second, six times, and ends as it began.

minecraft:chest_lid.name: Chest Lid
minecraft:chest_lid.description: A chest lid opens and closes with its sound; the contents stay untouched.

minecraft:barrel_opens.name: Barrel Opens
minecraft:barrel_opens.description: A closed barrel opens for a moment, then shuts again.

minecraft:jukebox_pop.name: Jukebox Pop
minecraft:jukebox_pop.description: A playing jukebox cuts its music and spits the disc out.

minecraft:locked_door.name: Locked Door
minecraft:locked_door.description: A door slams shut with a thud and cannot be opened for ten seconds.

minecraft:open_house.name: Open House
minecraft:open_house.description: At night, every closed wooden door nearby swings open.

minecraft:footsteps.name: Footsteps
minecraft:footsteps.description: A step sounds two blocks behind the player.

minecraft:creeper_hiss.name: Creeper Hiss
minecraft:creeper_hiss.description: A creeper fuse hisses close by, with no creeper in sight.

minecraft:three_knocks.name: Three Knocks
minecraft:three_knocks.description: Three knocks on the nearest wooden door, or from nowhere if there is none.

minecraft:crying_child.name: Crying Child
minecraft:crying_child.description: A high-pitched villager cry somewhere nearby.

minecraft:block_breaking.name: Block Breaking
minecraft:block_breaking.description: Stone, wood, glass or gravel breaks nearby, but nothing is broken.

minecraft:enderman_hiss.name: Enderman Hiss
minecraft:enderman_hiss.description: The sound of an enderman being stared at.

minecraft:chest_opens.name: Chest Opens
minecraft:chest_opens.description: A chest opens somewhere close by.

minecraft:breathing.name: Breathing
minecraft:breathing.description: Five breaths one block from the player, each louder than the last.

minecraft:distant_bell.name: Distant Bell
minecraft:distant_bell.description: A loud bell rings from about forty blocks away.

minecraft:phantom_jukebox.name: Phantom Jukebox
minecraft:phantom_jukebox.description: Music disc 11 plays from a spot nearby, with no jukebox there.

minecraft:music_cut.name: Music Cut
minecraft:music_cut.description: The background music stops and resumes on its usual schedule.

minecraft:whisper.name: Whisper
minecraft:whisper.description: A chat line from "???" with the player's own name, visible only to them.

minecraft:blindness.name: Blindness
minecraft:blindness.description: Blindness for six seconds, with a low cave sound.

minecraft:fatigue.name: Fatigue
minecraft:fatigue.description: Mining fatigue II for ten seconds.

minecraft:hunger_pang.name: Hunger Pang
minecraft:hunger_pang.description: Takes three food points, if the player has more than three bars.

minecraft:poison.name: Poison
minecraft:poison.description: Poison for five seconds; it cannot kill.

minecraft:levitation.name: Levitation
minecraft:levitation.description: Levitation for two seconds, then the fall.

minecraft:frostbite.name: Frostbite
minecraft:frostbite.description: The player freezes as in powder snow for about three seconds.

minecraft:cold_touch.name: Cold Touch
minecraft:cold_touch.description: One or two hearts of magic damage with a freezing sound; never lethal.

minecraft:trip.name: Trip
minecraft:trip.description: The player stops dead for a second.

minecraft:scorch.name: Scorch
minecraft:scorch.description: The player is set on fire for a second.

minecraft:wrath.name: Wrath
minecraft:wrath.description: Two to three and a half hearts of magic damage; never lethal.

minecraft:snatch.name: Snatch
minecraft:snatch.description: The item in the main hand is thrown about five blocks away.

minecraft:suffocation.name: Suffocation
minecraft:suffocation.description: A heartbeat, then the air bar drains and the player takes damage. Stops in light, in water, at three hearts or after fifteen seconds.

minecraft:shove.name: Shove
minecraft:shove.description: At the edge of a drop, the player is pushed toward it.

minecraft:toss.name: Toss
minecraft:toss.description: The player is thrown about five blocks straight up.

minecraft:thunder_knocks.name: Thunder Knocks
minecraft:thunder_knocks.description: Three knocks, then a bolt strikes nearby; a second hits the player if they have barely moved.

minecraft:embrace.name: Embrace
minecraft:embrace.description: Growing damage every second until the player is ten blocks from where it began. Stops at three hearts.

minecraft:hotbar_shift.name: Hotbar Shift
minecraft:hotbar_shift.description: The selected hotbar slot changes on its own.

minecraft:strange_name.name: Strange Name
minecraft:strange_name.description: An item is renamed to something creepy.

minecraft:book_page.name: Extra Page
minecraft:book_page.description: One creepy page is added to a book and quill or a written book; nothing is erased.

minecraft:shuffle_chest.name: Shuffled Chest
minecraft:shuffle_chest.description: The contents of a nearby chest are shuffled.

minecraft:wear.name: Wear
minecraft:wear.description: A tool loses ten percent durability; it never breaks.

minecraft:rot.name: Rot
minecraft:rot.description: A stack of food in the inventory turns into rotten flesh.

minecraft:vanishing_item.name: Vanishing Item
minecraft:vanishing_item.description: A stack moves from one nearby chest to another.

minecraft:map_marker.name: Map Marker
minecraft:map_marker.description: A red X appears on a filled map and stays there for good.

minecraft:false_compass.name: False Compass
minecraft:false_compass.description: A plain compass points at a spot 30 to 60 blocks away, and keeps doing so.

minecraft:wilted_flowers.name: Wilted Flowers
minecraft:wilted_flowers.description: Potted flowers nearby turn into dead bushes, and are restored after two minutes.

minecraft:withering_crops.name: Withering Crops
minecraft:withering_crops.description: Every grown crop nearby loses one growth stage.

minecraft:turning_frame.name: Turning Frame
minecraft:turning_frame.description: The item in an item frame rotates.

minecraft:new_sign.name: New Sign
minecraft:new_sign.description: A sign's front text becomes a creepy phrase; restored after a minute unless the player edited it.

minecraft:new_painting.name: New Painting
minecraft:new_painting.description: A painting becomes another one of the same size; restored after a minute.

minecraft:glass_wall.name: Glass Wall
minecraft:glass_wall.description: A wall in front of the player turns to glass for four seconds, with a motionless husk standing behind it.

minecraft:dry_cauldron.name: Dry Cauldron
minecraft:dry_cauldron.description: A water cauldron nearby is emptied.

minecraft:dead_ground.name: Dead Ground
minecraft:dead_ground.description: A ragged patch of grass under the player turns to dirt.

minecraft:shifting_floor.name: Shifting Floor
minecraft:shifting_floor.description: The floor under the player briefly turns into another kind of the same material.

minecraft:broken_bed.name: Broken Bed
minecraft:broken_bed.description: A nearby bed breaks and drops as an item.

minecraft:wall_hole.name: Wall Hole
minecraft:wall_hole.description: Two blocks of a thin wall vanish for thirty seconds, with no drops.

minecraft:cross.name: Cross
minecraft:cross.description: A plus of bone blocks stands on the ground for a minute.

minecraft:cat_hiss.name: Cat Hiss
minecraft:cat_hiss.description: A nearby cat hisses at nothing.

minecraft:dog_barks.name: Dog Barks
minecraft:dog_barks.description: A wolf turns away and barks at nothing.

minecraft:animals_stare.name: Animals Stare
minecraft:animals_stare.description: Animals nearby stop and stare at the player for three seconds.

minecraft:villager_stares.name: Villager Stares
minecraft:villager_stares.description: A villager stops and stares at the player for five seconds.

minecraft:bats.name: Bats
minecraft:bats.description: Five bats appear close to the player.

minecraft:open_pen.name: Open Pen
minecraft:open_pen.description: A closed gate beside animals swings open.

minecraft:wild_pet.name: Wild Pet
minecraft:wild_pet.description: A tamed pet loses its owner and turns on the player.

minecraft:copycat.name: Copycat
minecraft:copycat.description: A zombie wearing a copy of the player's armor appears behind them and attacks.

minecraft:cold_breath.name: Cold Breath
minecraft:cold_breath.description: A puff of breath at the player's face, as if in the cold.

minecraft:footprints.name: Footprints
minecraft:footprints.description: On sand or snow, puffs and step sounds appear where the player stood a second ago.

minecraft:local_rain.name: Local Rain
minecraft:local_rain.description: Rain falls over the player alone for six seconds.

minecraft:lost_time.name: Lost Time
minecraft:lost_time.description: At night, the clock jumps a thousand ticks forward for everyone.
